champion: Metastatic disease to the pacemaker site
ordered_diagnoses: Metastatic disease to the pacemaker site
Chronic inflammatory response to the pacemaker

facts.raw_span: A 70-year-old man
extensive nicotine use
remote history of laryngeal squamous cell carcinoma (7 years prior)
bladder urothelial carcinoma (10 years prior)
dual-chamber pacemaker implantation for sick sinus syndrome 9 months ago
tested positive for COVID-19 infection, but his fatigue, dyspnea, and cough persisted and worsened
new, painless but bothersome swelling over the pacemaker site
normal pacemaker function and a clinically unremarkable pocket
Chest ultrasound revealed a soft tissue mass with increased vascularity surrounding the device
CT imaging confirmed a soft-tissue mass around the pacemaker pocket
haematoma or infection was excluded
no signs of cardiac decompensation or cachexia
